description: Language-neutral golden cases for Syrmos 3.0 Phase R disruption exclusions. A CLOSURE-severity service notice suspends its affected line ids; the planner must route AROUND suspended track, and when the only path rides suspended track it must name the affected line and its notice (S10 'Suspended segment') rather than hand the rider a plan they cannot travel. Kotlin com.syrmos.core.domain.journey.DisruptionExclusion, web web-disruption.js and iOS DisruptionExclusion.swift must produce the EXACT expected result for each case. Line ids are compared normalized (trimmed + lowercased), so expected sets are lowercase.

suspendedLineIds.note: info severity never suspends a line
warning severity never suspends a line
a closure can name several lines; info alongside it is ignored
the feed's 'closed' variant maps to a closure just like 'closure' (parity with AdvisorySeverity.fromRaw)

optionUsesSuspended.note: an option on unaffected lines rides no suspended track
an option that boards a suspended line is flagged
no suspension means nothing to flag

classify.note: no active closure, the plain route stands with no exclusions
a route avoiding the suspended line exists; the naive plan used it, so it is disclosed as excluded
a closure on a line the trip never uses must NOT claim a detour: excludedLineIds is empty
the only path rides suspended track: name the line and its notice, never route through it
avoiding empty and the naive route does not touch suspended track (e.g. banned for other reasons): honest no-route, not a false suspension
